title: Why Do You Waver, O Mortal
summary: Anxiety is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you
lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you
source.lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Use the line before urgency gets to rename fear as wisdom.

evidence.coreClaim: Why do you waver, O mortal being? The Creator Lord Himself shall protect you
evidence.turn: The answer to fear is not bravado. It is remembrance of the One already holding you.
